Definition: a whitish spot on the skin
BiblicalUsage: 1) white patch of skin, brightness, bright spot (on skin); 2) (CLBL) bright spot, scar, blister, boil; 2a) resulting from fire; 2b) resulting from inflammation of the skin; 2c) possible sign of leprosy
